reset_safety.regfile_fields: analog_cfg/debug_cfg at reset defaults; island_en, ATB, receiver and observation enables, ENABLE, MODE8 0; MISO 0 and MISO_OE 0 with CS_N high

timing.method: OpenSTA on the recorded routed netlist and SPEF, using the specification clock periods.
timing.envelope_note: Nominal tt is inside the accepted envelope. The listed broad ss/ff corners do not replace qualification at 22–32 C and 3.15–3.35 V.

safe.note: Assembled provider-pad safety remains a separate gate.

clean.note: Requires the assembled pad ring and full-chip checks.

pad_toggle_screen.method:
The provider cells have no characterized maximum toggle frequency, so this screen derives one
from the Liberty arcs with an explicit, conservative eye budget (engineering screen, not a
qualification; no package/board/FPGA/SSO modelling):

hostio.target: 156.25 MHz DDR pins, 312.5 Mword/s ten-bit host boundary
hostio.qualification: Routed timing, real pad/board timing, clock tolerance and bounded interruptions required.

open_risks: Target timing, state cap and footprint must pass on the final routed source snapshot.
Accepted-envelope timing, real pads/board skew and full-chip assembly remain required.
GLS is functional and has no SDF; physical timing requires STA.
Observation wiring and fallbacks must be checked on the assembled physical chip.
